method: Full three cached source files read, SHA256/Git blobs checked against pinned tree. Original saved-track removal method body extracted with only TypeScript generic/type erasure and run in Node with pending mocked API promises.
findings: Domain is Spotify track identity/metadata, not exact file-byte equality. Existing reject-domain decision retained; user requested all repositories so source review continues.

Saved-track removal launches async IIFEs without awaiting them, clears model duplicates and resolves before API work finishes. Local51-track control returns with0completed,2pending batches and0model duplicates. No external API used.
Playlist removal instead serially chains batches after sorting descending positions. Starred-playlist reject lacks immediate return so source continues preparing operations; no external execution.

Track equality uses ID or lowercased name:first-artist with duration difference<2000ms. Tracks deemed duplicates are not added to seen maps; representative/order semantics differ from transitive connected components. Plain objects/in-membership include prototype keys; artist-array preconditions unchecked.

customFetch token-refresh branch returns raw second fetch response without rechecking response.ok/status. Header mutation assumes object representation, not Headers/tuple forms. Retry-After parses integer seconds and delays lack abort support; source-only findings.
Library fetch reduces pagination output as pages directly; actual promisesForPages return contract must be read next before concluding mismatch.
limits: No actual Spotify operation, fullapp runtime, UI/media or API-currentness claim. Deferred pHash/ASAN untouched.
